leads.title: The Education (Parents’ Bill of Rights) Amendment Act, 2023
leads.documents: Saskatchewan 2023 law requiring schools to obtain parental consent for students under age 16 who request use of gender-related preferred name or gender identity; passed while invoking the notwithstanding clause (section 33); subject to calls for repeal by human rights groups and legal action.

leads.title: Saskatchewan pair of statutes relating to domestic relations (2001)
leads.documents: Amended all provincial statutes relating to rights and obligations of married couples and common law couples to apply equally to all common law couples, whether opposite-sex or same-sex.

leads.title: Saskatchewan provision for three or more intentional parents
leads.documents: Documents that Saskatchewan (with British Columbia and Ontario) will grant parental status to three or more intentional parents, allowing for wider range of queer and trans families, in addition to or in place of birth parent.

leads.title: Provincial human rights acts - sexual orientation and gender identity protections (as of 2017)
leads.documents: Documents that as of 2017 all provinces, territories and federal government explicitly include sexual orientation and gender identity as prohibited grounds of discrimination; covers Saskatchewan employment, housing, public/private accommodations protections.
